cards.headline: Exact controls are useful; realism remains a separate job.
good_fit: glTF 2.0 / Blender / Substance Painter / Unreal / Unity synchronized MikkTSpace normal-map rendering
Symmetrical characters, vehicles, and weapons sharing mirrored UV islands across a centerline symmetry seam
Explaining why interpolated vertex normals N and tangents T lose orthogonality inside curved triangles and require T - (N.T)N
Multiplying the bitangent cross product by tangent.w in {-1, +1} so mirrored UV islands never invert normal-map bevels
not_for: Object-space normal maps that store world/object vectors directly without a tangent-space TBN basis
Un-textured or vertex-colored meshes with no normal map or anisotropic brushed-metal shading
Bump/height maps evaluated purely via screen-space dFdx/dFdy without pre-baked tangent-space normal textures
